boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Simpson spaces for studying, campus services, performances, recreation, and major college gatherings.

cards.title: Dunn Library
cards.subtitle: Academic resources and study spaces
cards.notes: Use the individual carrels, group study rooms, and collaborative areas for planned work sessions; the third floor also has quiet collaborative spaces.
cards.short_summary: A renovated three-level library with solo and group-focused work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson states that Dunn Library includes group study rooms, individual carrels, collaborative spaces, and quiet collaborative spaces on its third floor.
cards.access_notes: Library hours are posted on the official library page and vary by term.

cards.title: Kent Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Student services, events, and dining
cards.notes: Start here when you need student-facing offices or an event venue; check the current campus calendar or office information before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: Simpson’s central hub for services and hundreds of annual events.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson describes the Kent Campus Center as a hub with student services offices, an entertainment venue, and hundreds of events each year.
cards.access_notes: Dining Services, Student Activities, Counseling, Career Development, and Student Development are listed in or at Kent Campus Center.

cards.title: Blank Performing Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Home of Theatre Arts and Simpson Productions
cards.notes: Look for the season schedule and reserve tickets through Simpson Productions when a show interests you; the box office is in the building.
cards.short_summary: A named performance venue where Simpson’s theatre department and productions are based.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson identifies the Blank Performing Arts Center as the location of its Theatre Arts department and its in-person Simpson Productions box office.
cards.source_title: Simpson Productions Box Office | Simpson College
cards.access_notes: Performance admission and box-office hours vary by production; consult the current official listing.

cards.title: Amy Robertson Music Center
cards.subtitle: Music department location
cards.notes: Use this named campus destination when connecting with music faculty or locating department activity; confirm any rehearsal, lesson, or event access in advance.
cards.short_summary: The campus home listed for Simpson’s music department.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson lists the Amy Robertson Music Center as the location for its Music department contact.
cards.access_notes: Department office hours listed by Simpson are Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.; activity access may differ.

cards.title: Smith Chapel
cards.subtitle: Chapel and Campus Ministries
cards.notes: Check Chapel and Campus Ministries announcements for services or programs, and use the named building as the meeting point when an event is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel that also houses Chapel and Campus Ministries.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson lists Chapel and Campus Ministries at Smith Chapel and uses Smith Chapel in its commencement-day programming.
cards.access_notes: Office hours for Chapel and Campus Ministries are listed as Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.; event access varies.

cards.title: Cowles Fieldhouse
cards.subtitle: Athletic complex and commencement venue
cards.notes: Watch for campus athletic and major-college event details, then follow posted venue directions; this is Simpson’s designated commencement location.
cards.short_summary: A fieldhouse used for Simpson’s annual commencement ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson’s 2026 commencement details identify Cowles Fieldhouse as the location of the ceremony.
cards.access_notes: Event entry, seating, and access arrangements are set for each event; consult the current event information.

cards.title: Bill Buxton Stadium
cards.subtitle: Named athletic venue on campus
cards.notes: Use the official campus map to orient yourself before an athletics or campus event, and rely on the event organizer for entry and seating details.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed Simpson College athletic destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson’s official AED campus map identifies Bill Buxton Stadium as a named campus location.
cards.source_title: Simpson College AED Campus Locations Map
cards.access_notes: Venue access depends on scheduled activities; follow posted college and event guidance.

cards.title: Buxton Park Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Named green space on the Simpson campus map
cards.notes: Add this named arboretum to a daylight campus walk or an outdoor pause between commitments; stay on open, maintained campus paths and areas.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed arboretum adjoining Simpson’s campus spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson’s official AED campus map identifies Buxton Park Arboretum as a named location on the campus map.
cards.source_title: Simpson College AED Campus Locations Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access can be affected by weather, maintenance, and campus operations.

cards.title: Carver Science Center
cards.subtitle: Named academic building on campus
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate this academic building before class, a department appointment, or a scheduled science event; confirm room access with the host.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed science building within Simpson’s academic core.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson’s official AED campus map identifies Carver Science Center as a named campus location.
cards.source_title: Simpson College AED Campus Locations Map
cards.access_notes: Building and room access may be limited outside scheduled classes or events.

cards.title: Steven Johnson Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Named recreation facility on campus
cards.notes: Locate the facility through the official map before a workout or recreation visit, then verify current eligibility, hours, and equipment-use rules with Simpson.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson’s official AED campus map identifies the Steven Johnson Fitness Center as a named campus location.
cards.source_title: Simpson College AED Campus Locations Map
cards.access_notes: Access, hours, and use policies were not verified on the cited map; confirm them directly with the college.
